name: usage-band
description: Band above the prompt showing the model and effort, context %, cache hit rate, and session and weekly limits, with a click-to-expand row for tools, skills and MCP share of context

showCache.title: Show cache
showCache.description: Share of the last response's input read from the prompt cache, and the cache read and write token counts.

showTools.title: Show tools
showTools.description: Loaded tools share of the context window.

showSkills.title: Show skills
showSkills.description: Skills listed in context and their share of the context window.

showMcp.title: Show MCP
showMcp.description: MCP tools and the share of the context window the loaded ones use.

showSession.title: Show session limit
showSession.description: The five-hour rate-limit window and when it resets (subscriptions only).

showWeek.title: Show weekly limit
showWeek.description: The seven-day rate-limit window and when it resets (subscriptions only).
